{{Quote|Red Squadron, fix on General Lok's signal and prepare strafing run. On my lead.|Hawk Ryo|<ref name="War 1" />}}
'''Red Squadron''' was a squadron of [[Hunter-class starfighter|''Hunter''-class starfighters]] piloted by [[Je'daii|members]] of the [[Je'daii Order]] during the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire's]] [[Invasion of the Tython system|invasion]] of the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]]. In [[25,792 BBY]], [[Hawk Ryo]] led Red Squadron and [[Blue Squadron (Je'daii)|Blue Squadrons]] during the Je'daii's [[Battle of Shikaakwa|defense]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shikaakwa]], and on the orders of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Daegen Lok]], the squadron conducted a strafing run on a number of [[Rakatan annihilator]]s that were defending the main position of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on Shikaakwa.<ref name="War 1" />
